mentions.name: LLM-powered strategy game AI
mentions.description: This project hooks LLMs into strategy game decision-making to offer smarter AI decision making in games where the strategy can otherwise be dumb.
mentions.problem: Some games can be dumb in strategy space, so the player ends up winning every time.
mentions.audience: Personal use — the author's own gaming, purely for self-interest
mentions.source_excerpt:
hate how dumb some games can be in strategy space, trying to hook up some LLM's to offer smarter decision making

Purely for my own self-interest lol, so I don't win every time
